_doc: The memory map (words; addresses are 15-bit). ROM 0..rom_size-1 holds the lib; RAM starts at rom_size (= data_base: globals, then strings at +256 (str_size words), code at code_base, the staged-data count at init-1, staging at init, the stack from sp0 up); the console is the last cols*rows words of RAM. Read by cc_ref.py (LAYOUT), libbuild.js, uarch.py and the page generator. Objects (cc_ref.py): rt_base.. holds the runtime cells (rt_cells: HP, GCLIM, ..., G_FLO, G_FREE; then the collector's bitmap and its powers of two, rtlib.py MAP / POWT); vec_base and vectors are unused by the register machine (its traps call lib.json's entries); the heap is two semi-spaces of heap_size words from heap_lo, below the console; an object value is its address - objtag. rt_cells names the runtime cells from rt_base, vectors the jump table's entries from vec_base. A heap string is [hdr][len][bytes][0] (value: the first byte's address - STRTAG, like a literal's), an array [hdr][cap][len][ptr][elements] (value: the ptr word's address + arrtag; ptr points at the elements, inline until the array grows); hdr = -2 - words - kind (0 string, 1 array). strend (the last staging word, never staged: globals are at most 255) holds the string area's end, for the runtime's key lookups. The string area starts with "true" and "false" (cc_ref SEED: overlays on the page), for booleans made strings.
